title: Causal Discovery with False Positive Error Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.25376v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Causal discovery methods produce data-driven hypotheses about causal relationships, which may become new scientific findings or inform decisions about downstream interventions. In such settings, false positive causal claims can be more consequential than false negatives. Yet few methods target false positive error control in causal discovery, and existing error guarantees are often asymptotic and require strong versions of the faithfulness assumption. We introduce the $m$-conservative PC algorithm and prove that it controls false discovery rate in the linear Gaussian setting under an extremely weak version of the faithfulness assumption. In our framework, false positive error for causal graphs is defined based on the conditional-independence information they entail, yielding a metric that penalizes both false adjacencies and incorrect edge orientations. translated_title: 具有假阳性错误控制的因果发现
translated_abstract: 因果发现方法产生关于因果关系的数据驱动假设，这些假设可能成为新的科学发现，或为下游干预决策提供依据。在此类场景中，假阳性的因果论断可能比假阴性造成更严重的后果。然而，鲜有方法针对因果发现中的假阳性错误控制，且现有的错误保证通常仅为渐近性的，并需要较强版本的忠实性假设。我们提出了 m-保守 PC 算法，并证明在线性高斯设定下，该算法在极弱版本的忠实性假设下即可控制错误发现率（FDR）。在我们的框架中，因果图的假阳性错误基于其所蕴含的条件独立性信息来定义，由此得到的度量能够同时惩罚虚假邻接关系和错误的边方向。参数 m 则量化了算法复杂度与保证强度之间的权衡。
tldr: 提出m-保守PC算法，在线性高斯设定和极弱忠实性假设下实现了因果发现中错误发现率的有限样本控制，同时惩罚虚假邻接与错误边方向。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the m-conservative PC algorithm, which controls the false discovery rate in causal discovery under an extremely weak faithfulness assumption in the linear Gaussian setting.
